verdict.rationale: Marketing copy claims a business account can be opened "in minutes" and docs show broad self-serve API/product capabilities (accounts, cards, transfers, FX), suggesting fast technical onboarding, but there is no evidence of the full KYC/banking-license onboarding timeline, compliance review process, or a documented end-to-end 'week vs months' onboarding journey for founders switching from another bank. missing for 10: concrete onboarding timeline/process documentation, compliance/KYC turnaround evidence, independent founder testimonials confirming week-long full onboarding.
